title: Grounded exact rule is the zero-role refinement of the generic role-bundle rule
semanticClaim: The generic role-bundle Rule path and the grounded exact Rule path are not two semantic executors.
When roles(V,M_t)=∅, generic matching reduces to exact antecedent identity with an empty substitution.
Instantiation under that empty substitution leaves every output template unchanged.
explicitPremises: For the same generic matcher: match([], template, actual, bindings) iff template=actual and bindings=[].
For the same generic instantiator: instantiate([], value)=value.
exclusions: No structural unification power is attributed to classical grounded Modus Ponens.
The theorem does not derive the generic matcher laws from the v0.14 Foundation alone.
No RuleKind, grounded opcode, second matcher, or second execution path is introduced.
This theorem does not close GPR-01..06 or GPR-08..09.
